```{python}

metrics
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
subject <- params$subject
export_dir <- params$export_dir
dirs <- read_csv(file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_directions.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
ggplot(dirs, aes(x=direction_rad, fill=condition)) + geom_histogram(bins=36, alpha=.5, position="identity")
```
